name: Optical Flow Anomaly Detection
description: Detects unnatural motion patterns in video using optical flow analysis to identify AI-generated content.
useCase: Detecting deepfakes and AI-generated video through motion field analysis
mechanism: Computes dense optical flow between consecutive video frames and analyzes the resulting motion field for anomalies. AI-generated videos often produce unnatural flow patterns, such as inconsistent motion directions, unrealistic acceleration, or flow discontinuities at manipulation boundaries.
source: Amerini et al. (2019) - Deepfake Video Detection through Optical Flow Based CNN, ICCVW
algorithm: Dense Optical Flow (Farneback) + Flow Field Statistical Analysis
parameters: Flow method: Farneback, Pyramid scale: 0.5, Levels: 3, Window: 15, Iterations: 3
strengths:
• Captures temporal manipulation artifacts
• Works on face and full-scene deepfakes
• Robust against spatial post-processing
• Can localize manipulated regions in video
limitations:
• Requires sufficient motion in the video
• Static scenes produce weak signals
• High computational cost per frame pair
• Camera shake can introduce noise

references.title: Amerini, I. et al. (2019). Deepfake Video Detection through Optical Flow Based CNN. ICCVW.
